decisions.choice: Tema and Jetur: an oasis and a tribe
decisions.reason: Tema is an oasis in northwest Arabia (Job 6:19; Isaiah 21:14). Jetur's descendants were probably the Itureans of later times (1 Chronicles 5:19).

source.text: אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֞ם בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמֹתָ֔ם בְּחַצְרֵיהֶ֖ם וּבְטִֽירֹתָ֑ם שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֥ר נְשִׂיאִ֖ם לְאֻמֹּתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: These [are] they, [the] sons of Ishmael, and these [are] their names, by their villages and by their encampments, twelve princes according to their tribes.

en.L: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages and by their encampments, twelve princes according to their tribes.
en.B: These are Ishmael's sons, and these their names, by their villages and camps: twelve chieftains, each over his own tribe.
en.R: These were the sons of Ishmael, listed by their villages and camps. They became the leaders of twelve tribes.

es.L: Estos son los hijos de Ismael, y estos son sus nombres, por sus aldeas y por sus campamentos: doce príncipes según sus tribus.
es.B: Estos son los hijos de Ismael, y estos sus nombres, según sus aldeas y campamentos: doce jefes, cada uno al frente de su propia tribu.
es.R: Estos fueron los hijos de Ismael, nombrados según sus aldeas y campamentos. Llegaron a ser los jefes de doce tribus.

fr.L: Ce sont là les fils d’Ismaël, et ce sont là leurs noms, selon leurs villages et selon leurs campements : douze princes selon leurs tribus.
fr.B: Tels sont les fils d’Ismaël, et tels sont leurs noms, selon leurs villages et leurs campements : douze chefs, chacun à la tête de sa tribu.
fr.R: Ce sont les fils d’Ismaël, nommés d’après leurs villages et leurs campements. Ils sont devenus les chefs de douze tribus.

sw.L: Hawa ndio wana wa Ishmaeli, na haya ndiyo majina yao, kwa vijiji vyao na kwa kambi zao: wakuu kumi na wawili kufuatana na makabila yao.
sw.B: Hawa ndio wana wa Ishmaeli, na haya ndiyo majina yao, kwa vijiji na kambi zao: viongozi kumi na wawili, kila mmoja juu ya kabila lake.
sw.R: Hawa ndio wana wa Ishmaeli, kwa orodha ya vijiji na kambi zao. Wakawa viongozi wa makabila kumi na mawili.

vi.L: Đó là các con trai của Ích-ma-ên, và đó là tên của họ, theo làng mạc và theo đồn trại của họ, mười hai thủ lĩnh theo các bộ tộc của họ.
vi.B: Đó là các con trai của Ích-ma-ên, và đó là tên của họ, theo làng mạc và trại của họ: mười hai tù trưởng, mỗi người đứng đầu bộ tộc mình.
vi.R: Đó là các con trai của Ích-ma-ên, được kể theo làng mạc và trại của họ. Họ trở thành những người lãnh đạo của mười hai bộ tộc.

ko.L: 이들이 이스마엘의 아들들이고, 이것이 그들의 마을과 그들의 진영에 따른 그들의 이름이니, 그들의 지파를 따라 열두 족장이다.
ko.B: 이들이 이스마엘의 아들들이고, 이것이 마을과 진영에 따른 그들의 이름이다. 그들은 열두 족장이 되어 저마다 자기 지파를 다스렸다.
ko.R: 이들이 이스마엘의 아들들이다. 그들의 이름은 그들이 살던 마을과 천막 진영에 따라 적었다. 그들은 열두 지파의 지도자가 되었다.

decisions.choice: twelve princes: the promise of 17:20
decisions.reason: God had promised Abraham that Ishmael would father twelve princes (17:20). The twelve tribes of Ishmael stand beside the twelve tribes of Israel.

decisions.choice: villages and encampments: settled and nomad life
decisions.reason: The first word (chatser) means unwalled settlements; the second (tirah) means circles of tents, the camps of nomads (Numbers 31:10).

decisions.choice: chieftains
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the word chosen in 17:20 for tribal leaders; Literal keeps "princes".

decisions.choice: "열두 족장" (L, B); "열두 지파의 지도자" (R)
decisions.reason: The nasi is the head of a tribe, not a king; the twelve fulfil God's word in 17:20 (meaning decision). "족장" is the plain word for a tribal chief, as the English says "chieftains".

source.text: וְאֵ֗לֶּה שְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל מְאַ֥ת שָׁנָ֛ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְשֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֑ים וַיִּגְוַ֣ע וַיָּ֔מָת וַיֵּאָ֖סֶף אֶל־עַמָּֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And these [are the] years of [the] life of Ishmael: a hundred year[s] and thirty year[s] and seven years; and he breathed his last and died and was gathered to his peoples.

en.L: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael: 137 years. And he breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people.
en.B: Ishmael lived 137 years. His breath failed, he died, and he was gathered to his people.
en.R: Ishmael lived to be 137 years old. Then he died and joined his ancestors.

es.L: Y estos son los años de la vida de Ismael: 137 años. Y expiró y murió, y fue reunido con su pueblo.
es.B: Ismael vivió 137 años. Le faltó el aliento, murió y fue reunido con su pueblo.
es.R: Ismael llegó a tener 137 años. Entonces murió y se unió a sus antepasados.

fr.L: Et voici les années de la vie d’Ismaël : 137 ans. Et il expira et mourut, et il fut réuni à son peuple.
fr.B: Ismaël vécut 137 ans. Le souffle lui manqua, il mourut et fut réuni à son peuple.
fr.R: Ismaël a vécu jusqu’à 137 ans. Puis il est mort et il a rejoint ses ancêtres.

sw.L: Na hii ndiyo miaka ya maisha ya Ishmaeli: miaka 137. Naye akakata roho, akafa, akakusanywa kwa watu wake.
sw.B: Ishmaeli aliishi miaka 137. Pumzi yake ikakoma, akafa, akakusanywa pamoja na watu wake.
sw.R: Ishmaeli aliishi mpaka akawa na umri wa miaka 137. Kisha akafa, akajiunga na mababu zake.

vi.L: Và đây là số năm đời sống của Ích-ma-ên: một trăm ba mươi bảy năm. Rồi ông trút hơi thở cuối cùng và qua đời, và được về với tổ tông mình.
vi.B: Ích-ma-ên sống một trăm ba mươi bảy năm. Ông tắt hơi, qua đời, và được về với tổ tông.
vi.R: Ích-ma-ên sống đến một trăm ba mươi bảy tuổi. Rồi ông qua đời và về với tổ tiên.

ko.L: 그리고 이것은 이스마엘의 생애의 햇수이다. 백삼십칠 년이었다. 그리고 그는 숨을 거두고 죽어, 자기 백성에게로 모여 갔다.
ko.B: 이스마엘은 백삼십칠 년을 살았다. 그는 기운이 다하여 숨을 거두었고, 자기 조상들에게로 돌아갔다.
ko.R: 이스마엘은 백삼십칠 살까지 살았다. 그리고 죽어서 먼저 세상을 떠난 조상들 곁으로 갔다.

decisions.choice: gathered to his people: the same words as for Abraham
decisions.reason: Ishmael's death is told in the words used of Abraham (verse 8). He too was Abraham's son and received a blessing (17:20).

source.text: וַיִּשְׁכְּנ֨וּ מֵֽחֲוִילָ֜ה עַד־שׁ֗וּר אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י מִצְרַ֔יִם בֹּאֲכָ֖ה אַשּׁ֑וּרָה עַל־פְּנֵ֥י כָל־אֶחָ֖יו נָפָֽל׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And they dwelt from Havilah to Shur, which [is] before Egypt, as you go toward Asshur; before all his brothers he settled.

en.L: And they dwelt from Havilah to Shur, which is opposite Egypt as you go toward Asshur. He settled over against all his brothers.
en.B: Ishmael's people ranged from Havilah to Shur, which faces Egypt on the road toward Asshur. They made their home in defiance of all their kin.
en.R: Ishmael's descendants lived in the land between Havilah and Shur, which is east of Egypt, on the road toward Asshur. They lived at odds with all their relatives.

es.L: Y habitaron desde Havila hasta Shur, que está frente a Egipto según se va hacia Asur. Se estableció frente a todos sus hermanos.
es.B: El pueblo de Ismael recorría la región desde Havila hasta Shur, que está frente a Egipto, en el camino hacia Asur. Se establecieron desafiando a todos sus parientes.
es.R: Los descendientes de Ismael vivían en la tierra que hay entre Havila y Shur, al este de Egipto, en el camino hacia Asur. Vivían enfrentados con todos sus parientes.

fr.L: Et ils habitèrent depuis Havila jusqu’à Shour, qui est en face de l’Égypte quand on va vers Assour. Il s’établit face à tous ses frères.
fr.B: Le peuple d’Ismaël parcourait le pays depuis Havila jusqu’à Shour, en face de l’Égypte, sur la route d’Assour. Ils s’installèrent en bravant tous leurs parents.
fr.R: Les descendants d’Ismaël ont vécu dans le pays situé entre Havila et Shour, à l’est de l’Égypte, sur la route d’Assour. Ils étaient en conflit avec tous leurs parents.

sw.L: Nao wakakaa kutoka Havila hadi Shuri, iliyo kuelekea Misri unapokwenda upande wa Ashuru. Alikaa akiwakabili ndugu zake wote.
sw.B: Watu wa Ishmaeli walizunguka kuanzia Havila hadi Shuri, inayoelekeana na Misri katika njia ya kwenda Ashuru. Walifanya makao yao wakiwapinga jamaa zao wote.
sw.R: Wazao wa Ishmaeli waliishi katika nchi iliyo kati ya Havila na Shuri, mashariki ya Misri, katika njia ya kwenda Ashuru. Waliishi kwa ugomvi na jamaa zao wote.

vi.L: Và họ ở từ Ha-vi-la cho đến Su-rơ, đối diện Ai Cập, trên đường đi về phía A-si-ri. Ông định cư đối nghịch với tất cả anh em mình.
vi.B: Con cháu Ích-ma-ên sống rải rác từ Ha-vi-la đến Su-rơ, đối diện Ai Cập, trên đường đi A-si-ri. Họ lập nghiệp mà chống đối tất cả bà con mình.
vi.R: Con cháu Ích-ma-ên sống ở vùng đất giữa Ha-vi-la và Su-rơ, phía đông Ai Cập, trên đường đi A-si-ri. Họ sống bất hòa với tất cả bà con của mình.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 하윌라에서부터 앗수르로 가는 길에 있는 이집트 맞은편 술까지 살았다. 그는 자기의 모든 형제들과 맞서서 자리 잡았다.
ko.B: 이스마엘의 자손은 하윌라에서 술까지 퍼져 살았다. 술은 앗수르로 가는 길에 이집트를 마주하고 있는 곳이다. 그들은 모든 친족과 맞서며 살았다.
ko.R: 이스마엘의 자손은 하윌라와 술 사이의 땅에서 살았다. 술은 이집트 동쪽, 앗수르로 가는 길에 있었다. 그들은 모든 친척과 사이좋게 지내지 못했다.

decisions.choice: from Havilah to Shur: the desert south of Canaan
decisions.reason: Shur is the desert on the edge of Egypt (16:7; 20:1). Havilah is probably in Arabia (10:29). Ishmael's people ranged across the deserts from Egypt to Arabia, as far as the road to Asshur, perhaps Assyria or the Arabian Asshurim (verse 3).

decisions.choice: he settled over against all his brothers: the word of 16:12 fulfilled
alternatives: he fell (in battle) before his brothers
he settled east of his brothers
decisions.reason: The angel told Hagar that Ishmael would live "over against all his brothers" (16:12). The verb here, naphal "fall", may mean to settle (Judges 7:12) or to attack. "Over against" can mean in hostility or simply east of. The words recall the prophecy without settling which sense is meant.

decisions.choice: in defiance of (B); at odds with (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable follow the sense of 16:12, where the same phrase was rendered "at odds with" (m2).

decisions.choice: "맞서서" (L), "맞서며 살았다" (B), "사이좋게 지내지 못했다" (R)
decisions.reason: The words echo 16:12, where Ishmael was to live against all his brothers (meaning decision); Korean "맞서다" keeps the sense of opposition, and Readable says it plainly, as the English "at odds with" does.

source.text: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֥ת יִצְחָ֖ק בֶּן־אַבְרָהָ֑ם אַבְרָהָ֖ם הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־יִצְחָֽק׃

records.literal_gloss: And these [are the] generations of Isaac, son of Abraham. Abraham fathered Isaac.

en.L: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son: Abraham fathered Isaac.
en.B: This is the account of the family of Isaac, Abraham's son. Abraham became the father of Isaac.
en.R: This is the story of the family of Isaac, Abraham's son. Abraham was Isaac's father.

es.L: Y estas son las generaciones de Isaac, hijo de Abraham: Abraham engendró a Isaac.
es.B: Este es el relato de la familia de Isaac, hijo de Abraham. Abraham fue el padre de Isaac.
es.R: Esta es la historia de la familia de Isaac, el hijo de Abraham. Abraham era el padre de Isaac.

fr.L: Et voici les générations d’Isaac, fils d’Abraham : Abraham engendra Isaac.
fr.B: Voici l’histoire de la famille d’Isaac, fils d’Abraham. Abraham devint le père d’Isaac.
fr.R: Voici l’histoire de la famille d’Isaac, le fils d’Abraham. Abraham était le père d’Isaac.

sw.L: Na hivi ndivyo vizazi vya Isaka, mwana wa Abrahamu: Abrahamu akamzaa Isaka.
sw.B: Hii ndiyo habari ya jamaa ya Isaka, mwana wa Abrahamu. Abrahamu alimzaa Isaka.
sw.R: Hii ndiyo hadithi ya jamaa ya Isaka, mwana wa Abrahamu. Abrahamu alikuwa baba wa Isaka.

vi.L: Và đây [là] dòng dõi của Y-sác, con trai Áp-ra-ham: Áp-ra-ham sinh Y-sác.
vi.B: Đây là câu chuyện về dòng họ của Y-sác, con trai Áp-ra-ham. Áp-ra-ham sinh ra Y-sác.
vi.R: Đây là câu chuyện về dòng họ của Y-sác, con trai Áp-ra-ham. Áp-ra-ham là cha của Y-sác.

ko.L: 그리고 이것은 아브라함의 아들 이삭의 계보이다. 아브라함이 이삭을 낳았다.
ko.B: 아브라함의 아들 이삭의 집안 이야기는 이러하다. 아브라함이 이삭을 낳았다.
ko.R: 아브라함의 아들 이삭의 집안 이야기는 이러하다. 아브라함은 이삭의 아버지였다.

decisions.choice: the generations of Isaac: the story of Jacob and Esau
decisions.reason: This heading opens a new section (25:19-35:29). As "the generations of Terah" told Abraham's story (11:27), "the generations of Isaac" tell the story of his sons, above all of Jacob.

source.text: וַיְהִ֤י יִצְחָק֙ בֶּן־אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּקַחְתּ֣וֹ אֶת־רִבְקָ֗ה בַּת־בְּתוּאֵל֙ הָֽאֲרַמִּ֔י מִפַּדַּ֖ן אֲרָ֑ם אֲח֛וֹת לָבָ֥ן הָאֲרַמִּ֖י ל֥וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And Isaac was a son of forty year[s] when he took Rebekah, daughter of Bethuel the Aramean, from Paddan-aram, sister of Laban the Aramean, for himself for a wife.

en.L: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean of Paddan-aram, the sister of Laban the Aramean, to be his wife.
en.B: Isaac was forty when he took Rebekah as his wife. She was the daughter of Bethuel and the sister of Laban, Arameans of Paddan-aram.
en.R: When Isaac was forty years old, he married Rebekah. Her father Bethuel and her brother Laban were Arameans from Paddan-aram.

es.L: E Isaac tenía cuarenta años cuando tomó por mujer a Rebeca, hija de Betuel el arameo de Padán Aram, hermana de Labán el arameo.
es.B: Isaac tenía cuarenta años cuando tomó por esposa a Rebeca. Ella era hija de Betuel y hermana de Labán, arameos de Padán Aram.
es.R: Cuando Isaac tenía cuarenta años, se casó con Rebeca. El padre de ella, Betuel, y su hermano Labán eran arameos de Padán Aram.

fr.L: Et Isaac était âgé de quarante ans quand il prit pour femme Rébecca, fille de Béthuel l’Araméen de Paddân-Aram, sœur de Laban l’Araméen.
fr.B: Isaac avait quarante ans quand il prit Rébecca pour femme. Elle était la fille de Béthuel et la sœur de Laban, des Araméens de Paddân-Aram.
fr.R: Quand Isaac avait quarante ans, il a épousé Rébecca. Son père Béthuel et son frère Laban étaient des Araméens de Paddân-Aram.

sw.L: Naye Isaka alikuwa mwenye umri wa miaka arobaini alipomtwaa Rebeka, binti Bethueli Mwaramu wa Padan-aramu, dada wa Labani Mwaramu, kuwa mke wake.
sw.B: Isaka alikuwa na miaka arobaini alipomwoa Rebeka. Yeye alikuwa binti wa Bethueli na dada wa Labani, Waaramu wa Padan-aramu.
sw.R: Isaka alipokuwa na umri wa miaka arobaini, alimwoa Rebeka. Baba yake Bethueli na kaka yake Labani walikuwa Waaramu kutoka Padan-aramu.

vi.L: Và Y-sác được bốn mươi tuổi khi ông lấy Rê-bê-ca, con gái Bê-tu-ên người A-ram ở Pha-đan A-ram, em gái La-ban người A-ram, làm vợ.
vi.B: Y-sác được bốn mươi tuổi khi cưới Rê-bê-ca làm vợ. Bà là con gái của Bê-tu-ên và em gái của La-ban, những người A-ram ở Pha-đan A-ram.
vi.R: Khi Y-sác bốn mươi tuổi, ông cưới Rê-bê-ca. Cha bà là Bê-tu-ên và anh bà là La-ban là người A-ram, ở vùng Pha-đan A-ram.

ko.L: 그리고 이삭은 밧단아람의 아람 사람 브두엘의 딸이요 아람 사람 라반의 누이인 리브가를 자기 아내로 맞을 때에 사십 세였다.
ko.B: 이삭은 마흔 살에 리브가를 아내로 맞았다. 리브가는 밧단아람에 사는 아람 사람 브두엘의 딸이요, 라반의 누이였다.
ko.R: 이삭은 마흔 살에 리브가와 결혼했다. 리브가의 아버지 브두엘과 오빠 라반은 밧단아람에 사는 아람 사람이었다.

decisions.choice: Bethuel the Aramean, from Paddan-aram
decisions.reason: Paddan-aram, probably "the field of Aram", is the region around Haran in upper Mesopotamia, the Aram-naharaim of 24:10. The family is called Aramean by the land where they lived. Israel later confessed, "My father was a wandering Aramean" (Deuteronomy 26:5).

decisions.choice: "em gái" (Rebekah as Laban's younger sister); "anh" (R) for Laban
decisions.reason: Vietnamese has no word for "sister" that leaves age open. Laban acts for the family in chapter 24 while Rebekah is still unmarried, so the draft makes him the older; a reviewer may weigh this.

source.text: וַיֶּעְתַּ֨ר יִצְחָ֤ק לַֽיהוָה֙ לְנֹ֣כַח אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ כִּ֥י עֲקָרָ֖ה הִ֑וא וַיֵּעָ֤תֶר לוֹ֙ יְהוָ֔ה וַתַּ֖הַר רִבְקָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And prayed Isaac to YHWH on behalf of his wife, for barren [was] she; and let himself be entreated by him YHWH, and conceived Rebekah his wife.

en.L: And Isaac prayed to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for his wife, because she was barren; and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} granted his prayer, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
en.B: Isaac pleaded with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for his wife, because she was unable to have children. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} granted his request, and Rebekah conceived.
en.R: Rebekah could not have children, so Isaac prayed to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for her. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said yes to Isaac's prayer, and Rebekah became pregnant.

es.L: E Isaac oró {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} por su mujer, porque ella era estéril; y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le concedió su oración, y Rebeca su mujer concibió.
es.B: Isaac suplicó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} por su esposa, porque ella no podía tener hijos. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} atendió su súplica, y Rebeca quedó embarazada.
es.R: Rebeca no podía tener hijos, así que Isaac oró {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} por ella. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} respondió que sí a la oración de Isaac, y Rebeca quedó embarazada.

fr.L: Et Isaac pria {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour sa femme, car elle était stérile ; et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se laissa fléchir par lui, et Rébecca sa femme conçut.
fr.B: Isaac implora {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour sa femme, parce qu’elle ne pouvait pas avoir d’enfants. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} exauça sa demande, et Rébecca devint enceinte.
fr.R: Rébecca ne pouvait pas avoir d’enfants, alors Isaac a prié {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour elle. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a répondu oui à la prière d’Isaac, et Rébecca est tombée enceinte.

sw.L: Naye Isaka akamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa ajili ya mkewe, kwa sababu alikuwa tasa; na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akakubali maombi yake, na Rebeka mkewe akapata mimba.
sw.B: Isaka alimsihi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa ajili ya mkewe, kwa sababu hakuweza kupata watoto. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akayajibu maombi yake, na Rebeka akachukua mimba.
sw.R: Rebeka hakuweza kuzaa watoto, kwa hiyo Isaka alimwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa ajili yake. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akakubali ombi la Isaka, na Rebeka akapata mimba.

vi.L: Y-sác cầu khẩn {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho vợ mình, vì bà son sẻ; và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nhậm lời ông, và Rê-bê-ca, vợ ông, thụ thai.
vi.B: Y-sác khẩn nài {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho vợ mình, vì bà không thể có con. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nhậm lời ông, và Rê-bê-ca thụ thai.
vi.R: Rê-bê-ca không thể có con, nên Y-sác cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho bà. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nhận lời cầu nguyện của Y-sác, và Rê-bê-ca có thai.

ko.L: 그리고 이삭이 자기 아내를 위하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 간구했다. 그 여자가 아이를 낳지 못했기 때문이다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그의 간구를 들어주셨고, 그의 아내 리브가가 임신했다.
ko.B: 이삭은 아내를 위하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 간절히 기도했다. 아내가 아이를 낳지 못했기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그의 기도를 들어주셨고, 리브가는 임신했다.
ko.R: 리브가는 아이를 낳을 수 없었다. 그래서 이삭은 리브가를 위하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이삭의 기도에 응답하셨고, 리브가는 아기를 가졌다.

decisions.choice: she was barren: like Sarah before her
decisions.reason: Sarah too was barren (11:30), and Rachel will be (29:31). Each child of the promise comes as God's gift, not by human power. Isaac and Rebekah waited twenty years (verses 20, 26).

decisions.choice: prayed ... granted his prayer: one verb, used twice
decisions.reason: The verb ('atar) means to plead earnestly; in its passive form it means to let oneself be pleaded with, to grant the request. The repetition shows that the answer matched the prayer.

decisions.choice: for his wife: on her behalf
decisions.reason: The phrase (le-nokhach) usually means "in front of" or "opposite". Here it means for her, on her behalf; it may also suggest he prayed in her presence.

decisions.choice: se laissa fléchir par lui
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the passive sense of the verb that answers Isaac's pleading (m2): the LORD let himself be moved by him. French "se laisser fléchir" says this naturally; Balanced and Readable say plainly that he granted the request.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA" for the divine name, with "Gia-vê" as the setting's alternative
decisions.reason: As the terms note and the Vietnamese Psalms: the name is written in capitals like the English "the LORD"; the reader can choose "Gia-vê", the name as it was probably said.

decisions.choice: "cầu khẩn ... nhậm lời" (L), "khẩn nài ... nhậm lời" (B) for the one verb used twice
decisions.reason: Vietnamese has no verb that means both "plead" and "be pleaded with"; "nhậm lời" (grant a prayer) is the word that answers a plea, so the link between the two halves stays clear.

decisions.choice: a divine_name span with the default "주" and the alternative "야훼", the particle ("께", "께서") written outside the span
decisions.reason: As the Korean style guide sets for the divine name (section 7a): one particle fits both forms, since both end in a vowel. "여호와", the older Protestant form, is not used.

source.text: וַיִּתְרֹֽצֲצ֤וּ הַבָּנִים֙ בְּקִרְבָּ֔הּ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אִם־כֵּ֔ן לָ֥מָּה זֶּ֖ה אָנֹ֑כִי וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ לִדְרֹ֥שׁ אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And struggled together the children within her, and she said, if so, why [am] I this? And she went to inquire of YHWH.

en.L: And the children struggled together within her, and she said, "If it is so, why am I like this?" And she went to inquire of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: The children inside her crushed against each other, and she said, "If it is like this, what is happening to me?" So she went to seek an answer from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The two babies pushed and fought inside her. She said, "What is going on with me?" So she went to ask {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y los niños luchaban juntos dentro de ella, y ella dijo: «Si es así, ¿por qué estoy yo así?». Y fue a consultar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Los niños se golpeaban el uno al otro dentro de ella, y ella dijo: «Si esto es así, ¿qué me está pasando?». Así que fue a buscar una respuesta {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Los dos bebés se empujaban y peleaban dentro de ella. Ella dijo: «¿Qué me está pasando?». Entonces fue a preguntarle {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et les enfants se heurtaient en elle, et elle dit : « S’il en est ainsi, pourquoi suis-je ainsi ? » Et elle alla consulter {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Les enfants se bousculaient en elle, et elle dit : « S’il en est ainsi, que m’arrive-t-il ? » Elle alla donc chercher une réponse auprès {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Les deux bébés se poussaient et se battaient dans son ventre. Elle a dit : « Qu’est-ce qui m’arrive ? » Alors elle est allée interroger {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na watoto wakashindana ndani yake, naye akasema, "Ikiwa ni hivyo, mbona mimi niko hivi?" Akaenda kumwuliza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Watoto walisukumana tumboni mwake, naye akasema, "Ikiwa ni hivi, ni nini kinachonipata?" Basi akaenda kutafuta jibu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Watoto wawili walisukumana na kupigana tumboni mwake. Akasema, "Ni nini kinachonitokea?" Kwa hiyo akaenda kumwuliza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Và hai đứa con xô đẩy nhau trong lòng bà, và bà nói: "Nếu thế này thì sao tôi lại [ra] thế này?" Rồi bà đi cầu hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Hai đứa con trong bụng bà chen lấn nhau, và bà nói: "Nếu như thế này thì điều gì đang xảy ra cho tôi?" Vậy bà đi cầu hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Hai đứa bé đạp và giành nhau trong bụng bà. Bà nói: "Chuyện gì đang xảy ra với tôi thế này?" Vậy bà đi hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 아이들이 그 여자 안에서 서로 부딪쳤다. 그러자 그 여자가 말했다. "그렇다면 내가 어찌하여 이러한가?" 그리고 그 여자는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 여쭈러 갔다.
ko.B: 아이들이 리브가의 배 속에서 서로 밀치며 싸웠다. 리브가는 "이렇다면 나에게 무슨 일이 일어나고 있는 것인가?" 하고 말했다. 그래서 리브가는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 여쭈어 보러 갔다.
ko.R: 두 아기가 리브가의 배 속에서 서로 밀고 싸웠다. 리브가는 "나에게 무슨 일이 생긴 걸까?" 하고 말했다. 그래서 리브가는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 물어보러 갔다.

decisions.choice: struggled together: crushed one another
decisions.reason: The verb (ratsats) means to crush or press hard. The babies' struggle foreshadows the conflict between Jacob and Esau and their peoples.

decisions.choice: if so, why am I this?: words of distress
alternatives: If it is so, why do I live?
Why is this happening to me?
decisions.reason: Her words break off and are hard to render: "If so, why this I?" She may mean "if pregnancy is like this, why am I alive?" (the Syriac reads "why do I live?"), or simply "why is this happening to me?"

decisions.choice: to inquire of the LORD: to seek an answer from God
decisions.reason: The verb (darash) is used for consulting God, often through a prophet or at a place of worship (Exodus 18:15; 1 Samuel 9:9). The text does not say how or where Rebekah asked.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה לָ֗הּ שְׁנֵ֤י גוֹיִם֙ בְּבִטְנֵ֔ךְ וּשְׁנֵ֣י לְאֻמִּ֔ים מִמֵּעַ֖יִךְ יִפָּרֵ֑דוּ וּלְאֹם֙ מִלְאֹ֣ם יֶֽאֱמָ֔ץ וְרַ֖ב יַעֲבֹ֥ד צָעִֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: And said YHWH to her, two nations [are] in your womb, and two peoples from your inner parts will be separated; and a people than a people will be stronger, and [the] older will serve [the] younger.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to her, "Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples from within you will be divided; one people will be stronger than the other people, and the older will serve the younger."
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} told her, "Two nations are inside you; two peoples will come from your body and go separate ways. One will be mightier than the other, and the elder will be servant to the younger."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to her, "You have two nations inside your body. The two peoples who come from you will be split apart. One will be stronger than the other, and the older one will serve the younger one."

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo: «En tu vientre hay dos naciones, y dos pueblos salidos de ti se separarán; un pueblo superará en fuerza al otro pueblo, y el mayor servirá al menor».
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le respondió: «Llevas dos naciones dentro de ti; de tu cuerpo saldrán dos pueblos que tomarán caminos distintos. Uno será más poderoso que el otro, y el mayor estará al servicio del menor».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo: «Tienes dos naciones dentro de tu cuerpo. Los dos pueblos que nacerán de ti estarán separados. Uno será más fuerte que el otro, y el mayor servirá al menor».

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui dit : « Deux nations sont dans ton sein, et deux peuples issus de tes entrailles se sépareront ; un peuple sera plus fort que l’autre peuple, et l’aîné servira le cadet. »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui répondit : « Deux nations sont en toi ; deux peuples sortiront de ton corps et prendront des chemins différents. L’un sera plus puissant que l’autre, et l’aîné sera au service du cadet. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui a dit : « Tu portes deux nations dans ton corps. Les deux peuples qui viendront de toi seront séparés. L’un sera plus fort que l’autre, et le plus âgé servira le plus jeune. »

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia, "Ndani ya tumbo lako mna mataifa mawili, na jamii mbili zitakazotoka ndani yako zitatengana; jamii moja itakuwa na nguvu kuliko jamii nyingine, na mkubwa atamtumikia mdogo."
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamjibu, "Ndani yako kuna mataifa mawili; jamii mbili zitatoka mwilini mwako na kufuata njia tofauti. Moja itakuwa na nguvu zaidi kuliko nyingine, na yule mkubwa atakuwa mtumishi wa yule mdogo."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia, "Una mataifa mawili mwilini mwako. Jamii mbili zitakazotoka kwako zitatengana. Moja itakuwa na nguvu kuliko nyingine, na yule mkubwa atamtumikia yule mdogo."

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với bà: "Hai dân tộc ở trong lòng ngươi, và hai dân từ trong ngươi sẽ chia rẽ; dân này sẽ mạnh hơn dân kia, và đứa lớn sẽ phục dịch đứa nhỏ."
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với bà: "Hai dân tộc đang ở trong bụng con; hai dân sẽ ra từ thân thể con và đi hai ngả khác nhau. Dân này sẽ hùng mạnh hơn dân kia, và đứa lớn sẽ làm đầy tớ cho đứa nhỏ."
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với bà: "Trong bụng con có hai dân tộc. Hai dân ra từ con sẽ tách khỏi nhau. Dân này sẽ mạnh hơn dân kia, và người anh sẽ phục vụ người em."

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그 여자에게 말씀하셨다. "두 민족이 네 태 안에 있고, 두 백성이 네 속에서부터 갈라질 것이다. 한 백성이 다른 백성보다 강할 것이고, 큰 자가 작은 자를 섬길 것이다."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 리브가에게 말씀하셨다. "네 배 속에 두 민족이 있다. 네 몸에서 두 백성이 나와 서로 갈라질 것이다. 한 백성이 다른 백성보다 강할 것이고, 형이 아우를 섬길 것이다."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 리브가에게 말씀하셨다. "네 몸 안에 두 민족이 있다. 너에게서 나올 두 백성은 서로 나뉠 것이다. 한쪽이 다른 쪽보다 강할 것이고, 형이 동생을 섬길 것이다."

decisions.choice: two nations in your womb: Israel and Edom
decisions.reason: The twins will father two nations, Israel from Jacob and Edom from Esau (verse 30; 36:1). Their struggle in the womb foreshadows centuries of rivalry (Numbers 20:14-21; 2 Samuel 8:14; Obadiah 1:10).

decisions.choice: the older will serve the younger: God's choice reverses custom
decisions.reason: Custom gave the firstborn the lead. God's word puts the younger first, as with Isaac over Ishmael and later Ephraim over Manasseh (48:19). Paul cites this verse to show that God's choosing rests on his call, not on human merit (Romans 9:10-13).

decisions.choice: nations: a spelling difference
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text spell the word for nations in an unusual way (gyym); the Masoretes' marginal reading gives the usual spelling (goyim). The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: older and younger: "great" and "small"
decisions.reason: The words are rav, "great, many", and tsa'ir, "small, young", not the usual words for firstborn and youngest. They suggest both age and greatness.

decisions.choice: jamii (peoples)
decisions.reason: The second word for the nations (le'ummim) is a near synonym of the first. "Makabila" would make them tribes, and "watu wawili" would mean two persons, so Swahili uses "jamii", a people or community, beside "mataifa".

decisions.choice: God calls Rebekah "ngươi" (L) and "con" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The terms note: God speaking calls a person "ngươi" at Literal and "con" at Balanced and Readable, as a father speaks to his child; "ngươi" is older and more distant.

decisions.choice: "đứa lớn sẽ phục dịch đứa nhỏ" (L) and "người anh sẽ phục vụ người em" (R), the words of the Vietnamese Romans 9:12
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this line in Romans 9:12; the Vietnamese wording there is kept so the reader sees the same saying.

decisions.choice: "큰 자가 작은 자를 섬길 것이다" (L); "형이 아우를 섬길 것이다" (B); "형이 동생을 섬길 것이다" (R)
decisions.reason: The same words as the Korean Romans 9:12, which quotes this verse, at each level. Literal keeps the Hebrew "great" and "small" (meaning decision); God speaks in 해라체 with "너", as the terms note sets.

source.text: וַיִּמְלְא֥וּ יָמֶ֖יהָ לָלֶ֑דֶת וְהִנֵּ֥ה תוֹמִ֖ם בְּבִטְנָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And were completed her days to give birth, and there, twins [were] in her womb.

en.L: And when her days to give birth were completed, look, there were twins in her womb.
en.B: Her days of pregnancy came to an end, and there were twins in her womb.
en.R: At the end of her pregnancy, Rebekah gave birth to twin boys.

es.L: Y cuando se cumplieron sus días para dar a luz, he aquí que había gemelos en su vientre.
es.B: Se cumplió el tiempo de su embarazo, y tenía gemelos en el vientre.
es.R: Al final de su embarazo, Rebeca dio a luz a dos niños gemelos.

fr.L: Et quand ses jours pour enfanter furent accomplis, voici, il y avait des jumeaux dans son sein.
fr.B: Quand arriva le terme de sa grossesse, elle portait des jumeaux.
fr.R: À la fin de sa grossesse, Rébecca a mis au monde des jumeaux, deux garçons.

sw.L: Na siku zake za kuzaa zilipotimia, tazama, walikuwa mapacha tumboni mwake.
sw.B: Siku za mimba yake zilipotimia, kumbe walikuwa mapacha tumboni mwake.
sw.R: Mimba yake ilipofika mwisho, Rebeka alizaa mapacha wa kiume.

vi.L: Và khi những ngày sinh nở của bà đã trọn, kìa, có hai đứa sinh đôi trong lòng bà.
vi.B: Đến kỳ sinh nở, trong bụng bà có hai đứa sinh đôi.
vi.R: Đến lúc sinh, Rê-bê-ca sinh ra hai bé trai song sinh.

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자의 해산할 날이 찼을 때, 보라, 쌍둥이가 그 여자의 태 안에 있었다.
ko.B: 리브가가 해산할 날이 되었는데, 배 속에 쌍둥이가 있었다.
ko.R: 아기를 낳을 때가 되자 리브가는 쌍둥이 아들을 낳았다.

source.text: וַיֵּצֵ֤א הָרִאשׁוֹן֙ אַדְמוֹנִ֔י כֻּלּ֖וֹ כְּאַדֶּ֣רֶת שֵׂעָ֑ר וַיִּקְרְא֥וּ שְׁמ֖וֹ עֵשָֽׂו׃

records.literal_gloss: And came out the first, red, all of him like a cloak of hair; and they called his name Esau.

en.L: And the first came out red, all of him like a hairy cloak, and they called his name Esau.
en.B: The first one came out reddish, his whole body covered with hair like a fur cloak, and they named him Esau.
en.R: The first baby was red, and he was covered with hair like a fur coat. So they named him Esau.

es.L: Y salió el primero rojizo, todo él como un manto de pelo, y lo llamaron por nombre Esaú.
es.B: El primero salió rojizo, con todo el cuerpo cubierto de vello como un manto de piel, y lo llamaron Esaú.
es.R: El primer bebé era rojo y estaba cubierto de pelo como si llevara un abrigo de piel. Por eso lo llamaron Esaú.

fr.L: Et le premier sortit roux, tout entier comme un manteau de poil, et ils appelèrent son nom Ésaü.
fr.B: Le premier sortit tout rougeâtre, le corps entier couvert de poils comme d’un manteau de fourrure, et on lui donna le nom d’Ésaü.
fr.R: Le premier bébé était rouge, et il était couvert de poils comme d’un manteau de fourrure. On l’a donc appelé Ésaü.

sw.L: Na wa kwanza akatoka mwekundu, mwili wake wote kama joho la nywele, wakamwita jina lake Esau.
sw.B: Wa kwanza alitoka akiwa mwekundu, mwili wake wote umejaa nywele kama vazi la manyoya, wakampa jina Esau.
sw.R: Mtoto wa kwanza alikuwa mwekundu, naye alikuwa amefunikwa na nywele kama koti la manyoya. Kwa hiyo wakamwita Esau.

vi.L: Đứa thứ nhất ra, đỏ hồng, toàn thân như một áo choàng lông, và người ta gọi tên nó là Ê-sau.
vi.B: Đứa ra trước có da đo đỏ, khắp mình đầy lông như mặc áo lông thú, và họ đặt tên nó là Ê-sau.
vi.R: Đứa bé thứ nhất có da đỏ, và khắp người đầy lông như mặc áo lông thú. Vì vậy người ta đặt tên nó là Ê-sau.

ko.L: 그리고 먼저 나온 아이는 붉었고, 온몸이 털옷 같았다. 그래서 그들은 그의 이름을 에서라고 불렀다.
ko.B: 먼저 나온 아이는 불그스름했고, 온몸이 털옷처럼 털로 덮여 있었다. 그래서 그들은 그 아이의 이름을 에서라고 지었다.
ko.R: 첫째 아기는 몸이 붉었고, 털옷을 입은 것처럼 털이 많았다. 그래서 사람들은 그 아기의 이름을 에서라고 지었다.

decisions.choice: red ('admoni): a play on Edom
decisions.reason: The word for red sounds like Edom, the nation that will come from Esau (verse 30). David too is called 'admoni, ruddy (1 Samuel 16:12).

decisions.choice: hair (se'ar): a play on Seir and on Esau
decisions.reason: "Hair" (se'ar) sounds like Seir, the hill country of Edom where Esau will live (32:4; 36:8). The name Esau itself is not explained, but its sound goes with "hairy" (27:11).

decisions.choice: "붉었고", "털옷" with the names "에서" and "에돔" left unexplained here
alternatives: a note in the text on 'admoni and se'ar
decisions.reason: The wordplay on Edom and Seir (meaning decisions) cannot be heard in Korean; as the English does at this verse, the text keeps the plain words and leaves the wordplay to the notes.

source.text: וְאַֽחֲרֵי־כֵ֞ן יָצָ֣א אָחִ֗יו וְיָד֤וֹ אֹחֶ֨זֶת֙ בַּעֲקֵ֣ב עֵשָׂ֔ו וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְיִצְחָ֛ק בֶּן־שִׁשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בְּלֶ֥דֶת אֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And after that came out his brother, and his hand [was] holding on [the] heel of Esau; and he called his name Jacob. And Isaac [was] a son of sixty year[s] when she bore them.

en.L: And after that his brother came out, his hand holding on to Esau's heel, and he called his name Jacob. And Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.
en.B: Next came his brother, his hand clutching Esau's heel, and he was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old at their birth.
en.R: Then his brother was born. He was holding on to Esau's heel with his hand. So he was named Jacob, which sounds like the word for "heel." Isaac was sixty years old when they were born.

es.L: Y después salió su hermano, con su mano agarrada al talón de Esaú, y le llamó por nombre Jacob. E Isaac tenía sesenta años cuando ella los dio a luz.
es.B: Luego salió su hermano, con la mano aferrada al talón de Esaú, y se le puso por nombre Jacob. Isaac tenía sesenta años cuando nacieron.
es.R: Después nació su hermano. Venía agarrado del talón de Esaú con la mano. Por eso lo llamaron Jacob, que suena como la palabra hebrea para «talón». Isaac tenía sesenta años cuando ellos nacieron.

fr.L: Et après cela sortit son frère, sa main tenant le talon d’Ésaü, et il appela son nom Jacob. Et Isaac était âgé de soixante ans quand elle les enfanta.
fr.B: Ensuite sortit son frère, la main agrippée au talon d’Ésaü, et on le nomma Jacob. Isaac avait soixante ans à leur naissance.
fr.R: Ensuite, son frère est né. Il tenait le talon d’Ésaü avec sa main. On l’a donc appelé Jacob, un nom qui ressemble au mot hébreu pour « talon ». Isaac avait soixante ans quand ils sont nés.

sw.L: Na baada ya hayo nduguye akatoka, mkono wake ukishika kisigino cha Esau, naye akamwita jina lake Yakobo. Naye Isaka alikuwa na umri wa miaka sitini alipowazaa.
sw.B: Kisha akatoka nduguye, mkono wake umeshika kisigino cha Esau, akaitwa Yakobo. Isaka alikuwa na miaka sitini walipozaliwa.
sw.R: Kisha ndugu yake akazaliwa. Alikuwa ameshika kisigino cha Esau kwa mkono wake. Kwa hiyo akaitwa Yakobo, jina linalofanana na neno la Kiebrania la "kisigino." Isaka alikuwa na umri wa miaka sitini walipozaliwa.

vi.L: Và sau đó em nó ra, tay nắm lấy gót chân Ê-sau, và người ta gọi tên nó là Gia-cốp. Và Y-sác được sáu mươi tuổi khi bà sinh chúng.
vi.B: Kế đó em nó ra, tay nắm chặt gót chân Ê-sau, và nó được đặt tên là Gia-cốp. Y-sác được sáu mươi tuổi khi hai con ra đời.
vi.R: Rồi em nó ra đời. Tay nó nắm lấy gót chân Ê-sau. Vì vậy nó được đặt tên là Gia-cốp, nghe giống như chữ "gót chân" trong tiếng Hê-bơ-rơ. Y-sác được sáu mươi tuổi khi hai con ra đời.

ko.L: 그리고 그 뒤에 그의 아우가 나왔는데, 그의 손이 에서의 발꿈치를 잡고 있었다. 그래서 그가 그의 이름을 야곱이라고 불렀다. 그리고 그 여자가 그들을 낳았을 때에 이삭은 육십 세였다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 아우가 나왔는데, 손으로 에서의 발꿈치를 꼭 붙잡고 있었다. 그래서 그 아이의 이름을 야곱이라고 했다. 리브가가 쌍둥이를 낳았을 때 이삭은 예순 살이었다.
ko.R: 그다음에 동생이 태어났다. 동생은 손으로 에서의 발꿈치를 잡고 있었다. 그래서 그 아기의 이름을 야곱이라고 지었다. 야곱은 "발꿈치"라는 말과 소리가 비슷하다. 쌍둥이가 태어났을 때 이삭은 예순 살이었다.

decisions.choice: heel ('aqev) and Jacob (ya'aqov)
decisions.reason: The name Jacob sounds like "heel": "he grabs the heel". The verb from the same root means to trip up, to supplant; Esau later says Jacob is well named, for he has "cheated" him twice (27:36; Hosea 12:4). The name itself may originally have meant "may God protect".

decisions.choice: he called: who named him?
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "he called", perhaps Isaac, or "one called" (that is, "he was called"). The Samaritan Pentateuch and some ancient versions read "they called", as in verse 25.

decisions.choice: Isaac was sixty: twenty years of waiting
decisions.reason: Isaac married at forty (verse 20); the twins were born twenty years later, an answer to long prayer (verse 21).

decisions.choice: he was named
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable leave the one who named him open, as the Hebrew may (m2).

decisions.choice: which sounds like the word for "heel"
decisions.reason: Readable explains the wordplay (m1).

decisions.choice: que suena como la palabra hebrea para «talón»
decisions.reason: The English Readable explains the wordplay (m1). The Spanish word for heel does not sound like Jacob, so Readable says it is the Hebrew word that does.

decisions.choice: un nom qui ressemble au mot hébreu pour « talon »
decisions.reason: The English Readable explains the wordplay (m1). The French word for heel does not sound like Jacob, so Readable says it is the Hebrew word that does.

decisions.choice: jina linalofanana na neno la Kiebrania la "kisigino"
decisions.reason: The English Readable explains the wordplay (m1). The Swahili word for heel does not sound like Jacob, so Readable says it is the Hebrew word that does.

decisions.choice: "nghe giống như chữ "gót chân" trong tiếng Hê-bơ-rơ" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, the wordplay on the name is said aloud. Vietnamese adds "in Hebrew", since the Vietnamese word for heel ("gót chân") does not sound like the name.

decisions.choice: "야곱은 '발꿈치'라는 말과 소리가 비슷하다" (R)
decisions.reason: The name Jacob sounds like the Hebrew word for heel (meaning decision). As the English Readable does, Readable says so in the text; Literal and Balanced leave it to the note.

decisions.choice: "이름을 야곱이라고 했다" with no subject (B)
decisions.reason: Who named the child is unclear in the Hebrew (meaning decision); Korean can leave the subject out, as the English "he was named" does.

source.text: וַֽיִּגְדְּלוּ֙ הַנְּעָרִ֔ים וַיְהִ֣י עֵשָׂ֗ו אִ֛ישׁ יֹדֵ֥עַ צַ֖יִד אִ֣ישׁ שָׂדֶ֑ה וְיַעֲקֹב֙ אִ֣ישׁ תָּ֔ם יֹשֵׁ֖ב אֹהָלִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And grew up the boys, and was Esau a man knowing hunting, a man of [the] field; and Jacob [was] a man quiet, dwelling [in] tents.

en.L: And the boys grew up, and Esau was a man skilled in hunting, a man of the field, and Jacob was a quiet man, dwelling in tents.
en.B: When the boys were grown, Esau was a skilled hunter, at home in the wild, but Jacob was a steady man who lived among the tents.
en.R: As the boys grew up, Esau became a good hunter. He loved to be out in the open country. But Jacob was a quiet man who stayed near the tents.

es.L: Y crecieron los muchachos, y Esaú fue un hombre diestro en la caza, un hombre del campo, y Jacob era un hombre tranquilo, que habitaba en tiendas.
es.B: Cuando los muchachos crecieron, Esaú llegó a ser un cazador hábil, hecho a la vida del campo, mientras que Jacob era un hombre sosegado que vivía entre las tiendas.
es.R: Los muchachos crecieron. Esaú se hizo un buen cazador. Le encantaba estar al aire libre en el campo. Pero Jacob era un hombre tranquilo, que se quedaba cerca de las tiendas.

fr.L: Et les garçons grandirent, et Ésaü fut un homme sachant chasser, un homme des champs, et Jacob était un homme tranquille, habitant sous des tentes.
fr.B: Quand les garçons eurent grandi, Ésaü devint un chasseur habile, un homme de la campagne, tandis que Jacob était un homme posé, qui vivait parmi les tentes.
fr.R: Les garçons ont grandi. Ésaü est devenu un bon chasseur. Il aimait être dehors, dans la campagne. Mais Jacob était un homme calme, qui restait près des tentes.

sw.L: Na vijana wakakua, naye Esau akawa mtu ajuaye kuwinda, mtu wa porini; na Yakobo alikuwa mtu mtulivu, akikaa katika mahema.
sw.B: Vijana hao walipokua, Esau akawa mwindaji stadi, mtu wa porini, lakini Yakobo alikuwa mtu mtulivu aliyeishi mahemani.
sw.R: Wavulana hao walipokuwa wakikua, Esau akawa mwindaji hodari. Alipenda kukaa porini. Lakini Yakobo alikuwa mtu mpole aliyebaki karibu na mahema.

vi.L: Và các cậu bé lớn lên, và Ê-sau là một người giỏi săn bắn, một người của đồng nội; còn Gia-cốp là một người trầm lặng, ở trong các trại.
vi.B: Khi hai cậu bé lớn lên, Ê-sau trở thành một thợ săn giỏi, quen sống ngoài đồng nội; còn Gia-cốp là người điềm đạm, sống trong trại.
vi.R: Khi hai cậu lớn lên, Ê-sau trở thành một thợ săn giỏi. Ông thích ở ngoài đồng. Còn Gia-cốp là người trầm lặng, thường ở gần các lều trại.

ko.L: 그리고 아이들이 자랐다. 에서는 사냥을 아는 사람, 들의 사람이 되었고, 야곱은 조용한 사람이어서 장막에 머물렀다.
ko.B: 아이들이 자라서, 에서는 솜씨 좋은 사냥꾼이 되어 들에서 지내기를 좋아했고, 야곱은 차분한 사람이 되어 장막 가까이에서 살았다.
ko.R: 아이들이 자랐다. 에서는 사냥을 잘했고, 넓은 들판에 나가 있기를 좋아했다. 그러나 야곱은 조용한 사람이어서 천막 가까이에 머물렀다.

decisions.choice: quiet (tam): steady, settled
decisions.reason: The word tam usually means whole, blameless (Job 1:1; compare tamim of Noah, 6:9). Here, set against Esau the wild hunter, it seems to mean settled, even-tempered: a man of the camp and the flocks.

decisions.choice: a man of the field and a man of the tents
decisions.reason: The hunter roams the wild; the herdsman stays near the tents with the flocks. The contrast prepares for the story that follows.

decisions.choice: "조용한" (L, R), "차분한" (B) for tam
decisions.reason: Tam here describes a settled, steady man in contrast with the wild hunter, not his moral character (meaning decision); "조용한" and "차분한" say that without praising or blaming him.

source.text: וַיֶּאֱהַ֥ב יִצְחָ֛ק אֶת־עֵשָׂ֖ו כִּי־צַ֣יִד בְּפִ֑יו וְרִבְקָ֖ה אֹהֶ֥בֶת אֶֽת־יַעֲקֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And loved Isaac Esau, for game [was] in his mouth; and Rebekah [was] loving Jacob.

en.L: And Isaac loved Esau, because game was in his mouth, but Rebekah loved Jacob.
en.B: Isaac loved Esau, since he enjoyed the meat Esau hunted, but Rebekah loved Jacob.
en.R: Isaac loved Esau best because Esau brought him meat from his hunting, and he liked to eat it. But Rebekah loved Jacob best.

es.L: E Isaac amaba a Esaú, porque la caza estaba en su boca; pero Rebeca amaba a Jacob.
es.B: Isaac quería a Esaú, porque le gustaba la carne de lo que Esaú cazaba, pero Rebeca quería a Jacob.
es.R: Isaac quería más a Esaú, porque Esaú le traía carne de sus cacerías y a él le gustaba comerla. Pero Rebeca quería más a Jacob.

fr.L: Et Isaac aimait Ésaü, car le gibier était dans sa bouche, mais Rébecca aimait Jacob.
fr.B: Isaac aimait Ésaü, parce qu’il appréciait le gibier qu’Ésaü chassait, mais Rébecca aimait Jacob.
fr.R: Isaac préférait Ésaü, parce qu’Ésaü lui rapportait de la viande de sa chasse, et il aimait en manger. Mais Rébecca préférait Jacob.

sw.L: Naye Isaka akampenda Esau, kwa sababu mawindo yalikuwa kinywani mwake; lakini Rebeka alimpenda Yakobo.
sw.B: Isaka alimpenda Esau, kwa kuwa alifurahia nyama ya mawindo ya Esau, lakini Rebeka alimpenda Yakobo.
sw.R: Isaka alimpenda Esau kuliko Yakobo, kwa sababu Esau alimletea nyama ya mawindo yake, naye alipenda kuila. Lakini Rebeka alimpenda Yakobo kuliko Esau.

vi.L: Và Y-sác thương Ê-sau, vì thịt thú săn ở trong miệng ông; còn Rê-bê-ca thương Gia-cốp.
vi.B: Y-sác thương Ê-sau, vì ông thích ăn thịt thú rừng Ê-sau săn được; còn Rê-bê-ca thương Gia-cốp.
vi.R: Y-sác thương Ê-sau hơn, vì Ê-sau đem thịt thú săn về cho ông, và ông thích ăn món ấy. Còn Rê-bê-ca thương Gia-cốp hơn.

ko.L: 그리고 이삭은 에서를 사랑했다. 사냥한 고기가 그의 입에 [맞았기] 때문이다. 그러나 리브가는 야곱을 사랑했다.
ko.B: 이삭은 에서가 사냥해 온 고기를 즐겨 먹었기 때문에 에서를 사랑했지만, 리브가는 야곱을 사랑했다.
ko.R: 이삭은 에서를 더 사랑했다. 에서가 사냥해서 가져오는 고기를 좋아했기 때문이다. 그러나 리브가는 야곱을 더 사랑했다.

decisions.choice: game was in his mouth: he liked to eat game
decisions.reason: The phrase means Isaac enjoyed the wild game Esau hunted (27:3-4). The reason given for his love is his appetite.

decisions.choice: Rebekah was loving Jacob: a lasting love
decisions.reason: Isaac's love is told with an ordinary past verb; Rebekah's with a participle, which may suggest a love that continued. The parents' favorites set up the conflict of chapter 27.

decisions.choice: best
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that each parent had a favorite, which the verse implies.

source.text: וַיָּ֥זֶד יַעֲקֹ֖ב נָזִ֑יד וַיָּבֹ֥א עֵשָׂ֛ו מִן־הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וְה֥וּא עָיֵֽף׃

records.literal_gloss: And cooked Jacob a stew, and came Esau from the field, and he [was] exhausted.

en.L: And Jacob cooked a stew, and Esau came in from the field, and he was exhausted.
en.B: One day Jacob had made a stew, and Esau came in from the open country, worn out.
en.R: One day Jacob made some stew. Esau came home from hunting in the open country. He was very tired and hungry.

es.L: Y guisó Jacob un guiso, y llegó Esaú del campo, y venía agotado.
es.B: Un día Jacob había preparado un guiso, y Esaú llegó del campo, rendido.
es.R: Un día Jacob hizo un guiso. Esaú volvió a casa después de cazar en el campo. Estaba muy cansado y con hambre.

fr.L: Et Jacob fit cuire un ragoût, et Ésaü revint des champs, et il était épuisé.
fr.B: Un jour, Jacob avait préparé un ragoût, et Ésaü rentra de la campagne, épuisé.
fr.R: Un jour, Jacob a fait un ragoût. Ésaü est rentré de la chasse dans la campagne. Il était très fatigué et il avait faim.

sw.L: Na Yakobo akapika mchuzi, naye Esau akaja kutoka porini, naye alikuwa amechoka.
sw.B: Siku moja Yakobo alikuwa amepika mchuzi, naye Esau akaingia kutoka porini, amechoka kabisa.
sw.R: Siku moja Yakobo alipika mchuzi. Esau akarudi nyumbani kutoka kuwinda porini. Alikuwa amechoka sana, tena ana njaa.

vi.L: Và Gia-cốp nấu một món canh hầm, và Ê-sau từ đồng về, và ông kiệt sức.
vi.B: Một hôm Gia-cốp đang nấu canh hầm, thì Ê-sau từ ngoài đồng về, mệt lả.
vi.R: Một hôm Gia-cốp nấu canh hầm. Ê-sau đi săn ngoài đồng về. Ông rất mệt và đói.

ko.L: 그리고 야곱이 죽을 끓였는데, 에서가 들에서 돌아왔다. 그는 지쳐 있었다.
ko.B: 어느 날 야곱이 죽을 끓이고 있는데, 에서가 들에서 녹초가 되어 돌아왔다.
ko.R: 어느 날 야곱이 죽을 끓였다. 에서는 들판에서 사냥을 하다가 돌아왔다. 에서는 몹시 지치고 배가 고팠다.

decisions.choice: cooked a stew: a play on words
decisions.reason: The verb (zid) and the noun (nazid, "stew") come from the same root, which can also mean to act proudly or presumptuously; the narrator may hint at Jacob's scheming.

decisions.choice: exhausted ('ayef): faint from hunger and weariness
decisions.reason: The word means weary and faint, often with hunger or thirst (Judges 8:4-5; Isaiah 29:8).

decisions.choice: and hungry
decisions.reason: The word includes hunger (m2), as the next verse shows.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר עֵשָׂ֜ו אֶֽל־יַעֲקֹ֗ב הַלְעִיטֵ֤נִי נָא֙ מִן־הָאָדֹ֤ם הָאָדֹם֙ הַזֶּ֔ה כִּ֥י עָיֵ֖ף אָנֹ֑כִי עַל־כֵּ֥ן קָרָֽא־שְׁמ֖וֹ אֱדֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Esau to Jacob, let me gulp, please, from the red, the red, this, for exhausted I [am]; therefore one called his name Edom.

en.L: And Esau said to Jacob, "Let me gulp down some of the red stuff, this red stuff, for I am exhausted." Therefore his name was called Edom.
en.B: "Let me wolf down some of that red stuff, that red stuff there," Esau said to Jacob, "I am worn out!" That is how he came to be called Edom.
en.R: Esau said to Jacob, "Give me some of that red stew right now! I am starving!" That is why Esau was also called Edom, which means "Red."

es.L: Y dijo Esaú a Jacob: «Déjame engullir, te ruego, de lo rojo, de eso rojo, porque estoy agotado». Por eso se le llamó por nombre Edom.
es.B: «Déjame tragar un poco de eso rojo, de eso rojo de ahí», le dijo Esaú a Jacob, «¡estoy rendido!». Por eso se le llegó a llamar Edom.
es.R: Esaú le dijo a Jacob: «¡Dame ahora mismo un poco de ese guiso rojo! ¡Me muero de hambre!». Por eso a Esaú también lo llamaron Edom, que significa «Rojo».

fr.L: Et Ésaü dit à Jacob : « Laisse-moi avaler, je te prie, de ce rouge, de ce rouge-là, car je suis épuisé. » C’est pourquoi on appela son nom Édom.
fr.B: « Laisse-moi engloutir un peu de ce rouge, ce rouge-là, dit Ésaü à Jacob, je n’en peux plus ! » Voilà comment il en vint à s’appeler Édom.
fr.R: Ésaü a dit à Jacob : « Donne-moi tout de suite un peu de ce ragoût rouge ! Je meurs de faim ! » C’est pour cela qu’on a aussi appelé Ésaü Édom, ce qui veut dire « Rouge ».

sw.L: Na Esau akamwambia Yakobo, "Niache nimeze, tafadhali, sehemu ya kile chekundu, kile chekundu hiki, kwa maana nimechoka." Kwa hiyo jina lake likaitwa Edomu.
sw.B: "Niache nifakamie kidogo cha kile chekundu, kile chekundu pale," Esau akamwambia Yakobo, "nimechoka kabisa!" Ndiyo sababu akaja kuitwa Edomu.
sw.R: Esau akamwambia Yakobo, "Nipe sasa hivi kidogo cha mchuzi huo mwekundu! Nakufa kwa njaa!" Ndiyo sababu Esau aliitwa pia Edomu, maana yake "Mwekundu."

vi.L: Và Ê-sau nói với Gia-cốp: "Cho anh nuốt một ít [món] đỏ, món đỏ này, vì anh kiệt sức rồi." Vì thế tên ông được gọi là Ê-đôm.
vi.B: Ê-sau nói với Gia-cốp: "Cho anh ăn ngấu nghiến một ít món đỏ ấy, món đỏ đó, anh mệt lả rồi!" Vì vậy ông được gọi là Ê-đôm.
vi.R: Ê-sau nói với Gia-cốp: "Cho anh ăn ngay ít canh đỏ ấy! Anh đói quá!" Vì thế Ê-sau cũng được gọi là Ê-đôm, nghĩa là "Đỏ".

ko.L: 그리고 에서가 야곱에게 말했다. "제발 그 붉은 것, 이 붉은 것을 좀 삼키게 해 다오. 내가 지쳤다." 그러므로 그의 이름을 에돔이라고 불렀다.
ko.B: 에서가 야곱에게 말했다. "그 붉은 것, 거기 있는 그 붉은 것 좀 얼른 먹자. 나 지쳐 죽겠다!" 그래서 그의 이름을 에돔이라고도 부르게 되었다.
ko.R: 에서가 야곱에게 말했다. "그 붉은 죽 좀 당장 다오! 배가 고파 죽겠다!" 그래서 에서는 에돔이라고도 불렸다. 에돔은 "붉다"라는 뜻이다.

decisions.choice: let me gulp: eat greedily
decisions.reason: The verb (la'at) occurs only here; in later Hebrew it is used of feeding animals. Esau's words are crude and hurried.

decisions.choice: the red, the red ('adom): the name Edom
decisions.reason: Esau does not even name the food; he calls it "the red, this red". The word 'adom gives Edom its name, "Red", which also suits his red skin (verse 25) and the red sandstone of Edom's hills.

decisions.choice: which means "Red"
decisions.reason: Readable explains the name (m2).

decisions.choice: Esau says "anh" to himself and Jacob says "em" (verse 31 on), as twin brothers, Esau the elder
decisions.reason: The terms note: between brothers the older calls himself "anh" and the younger "em". Esau came out first (verse 25), so he is the elder.

decisions.choice: "nghĩa là "Đỏ"" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, the meaning of the name is said, so the link to the red stew is clear.

decisions.choice: Esau, the elder twin, speaks to Jacob in 해라체 ("해 다오", "지쳤다"); Jacob answers in 해요체 ("파세요") and calls him "형"
decisions.reason: The terms note's rule for brothers: the older speaks plainly to the younger, the younger politely to the older. They are twins, but Esau came out first, and the birthright he sells here is exactly the rank of the elder.

decisions.choice: "에돔은 '붉다'라는 뜻이다" (R)
decisions.reason: The name Edom sounds like the word for red (meaning decision); Readable says so, as the English Readable does.

source.text: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֑ב מִכְרָ֥ה כַיּ֛וֹם אֶת־בְּכֹֽרָתְךָ֖ לִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Jacob, sell, as the day, your birthright to me.

en.L: And Jacob said, "Sell me your birthright first, today."
en.B: Jacob answered, "First sell me your rights as the firstborn, here and now."
en.R: Jacob said, "First sell me your rights as the oldest son."

es.L: Y dijo Jacob: «Véndeme primero, hoy, tu primogenitura».
es.B: Jacob respondió: «Primero véndeme tus derechos de primogénito, aquí y ahora».
es.R: Jacob le dijo: «Primero véndeme tus derechos de hijo mayor».

fr.L: Et Jacob dit : « Vends-moi d’abord, aujourd’hui, ton droit d’aînesse. »
fr.B: Jacob répondit : « Vends-moi d’abord tes droits de premier-né, ici et maintenant. »
fr.R: Jacob a dit : « D’abord, vends-moi tes droits de fils aîné. »

sw.L: Naye Yakobo akasema, "Niuzie kwanza, leo, uzaliwa wako wa kwanza."
sw.B: Yakobo akajibu, "Kwanza niuzie stahili zako za mzaliwa wa kwanza, hapa hapa sasa hivi."
sw.R: Yakobo akasema, "Kwanza niuzie stahili zako za mwana mkubwa."

vi.L: Và Gia-cốp nói: "Hôm nay, trước hết, anh hãy bán quyền trưởng nam của anh cho em."
vi.B: Gia-cốp đáp: "Trước hết anh hãy bán quyền trưởng nam của anh cho em, ngay bây giờ."
vi.R: Gia-cốp nói: "Trước hết anh hãy bán cho em quyền làm con trưởng của anh."

ko.L: 그리고 야곱이 말했다. "오늘 먼저 형의 장자권을 나에게 파세요."
ko.B: 야곱이 대답했다. "먼저 맏아들의 권리를 지금 당장 나에게 파세요."
ko.R: 야곱이 말했다. "먼저 형이 가진 맏아들의 권리를 나에게 파세요."

decisions.choice: birthright: the rights of the firstborn son
decisions.reason: The firstborn son received a double share of the inheritance (Deuteronomy 21:17) and the place of head of the family. In Isaac's family it also carried the promise given to Abraham.

decisions.choice: as the day: right now, first
decisions.reason: The phrase (kayyom) means "today, at once", before anything else. Jacob seizes the moment.

decisions.choice: your rights as the firstborn (B); your rights as the oldest son (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the birthright was (m1); Literal keeps the single word.

decisions.choice: uzaliwa wa kwanza (L); stahili za mzaliwa wa kwanza (B); stahili za mwana mkubwa (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the single noun (bekhorah), "being firstborn". Balanced and Readable name the rights it carries (m1) with "stahili", entitlements, because the style guide keeps "haki" for righteousness. A reviewer may prefer the familiar "haki ya mzaliwa wa kwanza".

decisions.choice: "quyền trưởng nam" (L, B); "quyền làm con trưởng" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note sets "quyền trưởng nam" for the birthright; Readable says it in plain words, as the Vietnamese Hebrews 12:16 does at Readable.

decisions.choice: "장자권" (L); "맏아들의 권리" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The rights of the firstborn son: a double share and the head of the family's place (meaning decision). Literal keeps the term the Genesis note sets; Balanced and Readable say what it is, as the English "your rights as the firstborn" does and as the Korean Hebrews 12:16 says of this sale ("맏아들의 권리").

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר עֵשָׂ֔ו הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י הוֹלֵ֖ךְ לָמ֑וּת וְלָמָּה־זֶּ֥ה לִ֖י בְּכֹרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Esau, here, I [am] going to die; and what [is] this to me, a birthright?

en.L: And Esau said, "Look, I am about to die; so what is this birthright to me?"
en.B: "I am at death's door," Esau said. "What use is a birthright to me?"
en.R: Esau said, "I am dying! What good will it do me to be the oldest son?"

es.L: Y dijo Esaú: «Mira, yo me voy a morir; ¿y para qué me sirve a mí la primogenitura?».
es.B: «Estoy a las puertas de la muerte», dijo Esaú. «¿De qué me sirven a mí los derechos de primogénito?».
es.R: Esaú dijo: «¡Me estoy muriendo! ¿De qué me sirve ser el hijo mayor?».

fr.L: Et Ésaü dit : « Voici, moi, je m’en vais mourir ; à quoi me sert donc ce droit d’aînesse ? »
fr.B: « Je suis sur le point de mourir, dit Ésaü. À quoi me servirait un droit d’aînesse ? »
fr.R: Ésaü a dit : « Je meurs ! À quoi me sert d’être le fils aîné ? »

sw.L: Naye Esau akasema, "Tazama, mimi ninakaribia kufa; basi uzaliwa huu wa kwanza una faida gani kwangu?"
sw.B: Esau akasema, "Mimi niko karibu kufa. Stahili za mzaliwa wa kwanza zitanifaa nini?"
sw.R: Esau akasema, "Ninakufa! Kuwa mwana mkubwa kutanisaidia nini?"

vi.L: Và Ê-sau nói: "Kìa, anh sắp chết; vậy quyền trưởng nam này có ích gì cho anh?"
vi.B: Ê-sau nói: "Anh sắp chết đến nơi rồi. Quyền trưởng nam có ích gì cho anh?"
vi.R: Ê-sau nói: "Anh sắp chết rồi! Làm con trưởng thì có ích gì cho anh?"

ko.L: 그리고 에서가 말했다. "보아라, 나는 죽게 되었다. 그러니 이 장자권이 나에게 무슨 소용이냐?"
ko.B: 에서가 말했다. "내가 죽게 생겼다. 맏아들의 권리가 나에게 무슨 소용이 있겠느냐?"
ko.R: 에서가 말했다. "나는 배가 고파 죽을 지경이다! 맏아들이 된다는 것이 나에게 무슨 도움이 되겠느냐?"

decisions.choice: I am going to die: I am starving
alternatives: I will die one day anyway
decisions.reason: Esau may be exaggerating his hunger, or saying that as a hunter he lives with death daily and the future means little to him. Either way, he trades what lies ahead for what he wants now.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֗ב הִשָּׁ֤בְעָה לִּי֙ כַּיּ֔וֹם וַיִּשָּׁבַ֖ע ל֑וֹ וַיִּמְכֹּ֥ר אֶת־בְּכֹרָת֖וֹ לְיַעֲקֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Jacob, swear to me as the day; and he swore to him and sold his birthright to Jacob.

en.L: And Jacob said, "Swear to me first, today." So he swore to him and sold his birthright to Jacob.
en.B: "Swear it to me here and now," said Jacob. So Esau gave him his oath and sold his rights as the firstborn to Jacob.
en.R: Jacob said, "First make a promise to me with an oath." So Esau made the promise. He sold his rights as the oldest son to Jacob.

es.L: Y dijo Jacob: «Júramelo primero, hoy». Y él se lo juró, y vendió su primogenitura a Jacob.
es.B: «Júramelo aquí y ahora», dijo Jacob. Así que Esaú le hizo un juramento y le vendió a Jacob sus derechos de primogénito.
es.R: Jacob le dijo: «Primero hazme una promesa con juramento». Entonces Esaú se lo prometió. Le vendió a Jacob sus derechos de hijo mayor.

fr.L: Et Jacob dit : « Jure-moi d’abord, aujourd’hui. » Et il le lui jura, et il vendit son droit d’aînesse à Jacob.
fr.B: « Jure-le-moi ici et maintenant », dit Jacob. Ésaü lui prêta donc serment et vendit à Jacob ses droits de premier-né.
fr.R: Jacob a dit : « D’abord, fais-moi une promesse avec un serment. » Alors Ésaü a fait cette promesse. Il a vendu à Jacob ses droits de fils aîné.

sw.L: Naye Yakobo akasema, "Uniapie kwanza, leo." Akamwapia, akamwuzia Yakobo uzaliwa wake wa kwanza.
sw.B: "Niapie hapa hapa sasa hivi," Yakobo akasema. Basi Esau akamwapia, akamwuzia Yakobo stahili zake za mzaliwa wa kwanza.
sw.R: Yakobo akasema, "Kwanza uniahidi kwa kiapo." Basi Esau akaahidi. Akamwuzia Yakobo stahili zake za mwana mkubwa.

vi.L: Và Gia-cốp nói: "Hôm nay, trước hết, anh hãy thề với em." Vậy Ê-sau thề với Gia-cốp và bán quyền trưởng nam của mình cho Gia-cốp.
vi.B: Gia-cốp nói: "Anh hãy thề với em ngay bây giờ." Vậy Ê-sau thề với Gia-cốp và bán quyền trưởng nam của mình cho Gia-cốp.
vi.R: Gia-cốp nói: "Trước hết anh hãy thề hứa với em." Vậy Ê-sau thề hứa. Ông bán quyền làm con trưởng của mình cho Gia-cốp.

ko.L: 그리고 야곱이 말했다. "오늘 먼저 나에게 맹세하세요." 그래서 그가 그에게 맹세하고 자기 장자권을 야곱에게 팔았다.
ko.B: 야곱이 말했다. "지금 당장 나에게 맹세하세요." 그래서 에서는 맹세하고, 맏아들의 권리를 야곱에게 팔았다.
ko.R: 야곱이 말했다. "먼저 나에게 맹세하고 약속하세요." 그래서 에서는 맹세하며 약속했다. 그는 맏아들의 권리를 야곱에게 팔았다.

decisions.choice: swear to me: the oath makes the sale binding
decisions.reason: An oath called on God as witness. Jacob makes sure Esau cannot take back his word.

source.text: וְיַעֲקֹ֞ב נָתַ֣ן לְעֵשָׂ֗ו לֶ֚חֶם וּנְזִ֣יד עֲדָשִׁ֔ים וַיֹּ֣אכַל וַיֵּ֔שְׁתְּ וַיָּ֖קָם וַיֵּלַ֑ךְ וַיִּ֥בֶז עֵשָׂ֖ו אֶת־הַבְּכֹרָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And Jacob gave to Esau bread and stew of lentils; and he ate and drank and arose and went; and despised Esau the birthright.

en.L: And Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew; and he ate and drank, and rose and went his way. So Esau despised the birthright.
en.B: Then Jacob handed Esau bread and stew made of lentils. Esau ate and drank, got up and left. That was how little Esau cared for his birthright.
en.R: So Jacob gave Esau bread and a bowl of lentil stew. Esau ate and drank. Then he stood up and went away. Esau did not care about his rights as the oldest son.

es.L: Y Jacob dio a Esaú pan y guiso de lentejas; y comió y bebió, y se levantó y se fue. Así despreció Esaú la primogenitura.
es.B: Entonces Jacob le dio a Esaú pan y un guiso de lentejas. Esaú comió y bebió, se levantó y se marchó. Tan poco le importaban a Esaú sus derechos de primogénito.
es.R: Así que Jacob le dio a Esaú pan y un plato de guiso de lentejas. Esaú comió y bebió. Luego se levantó y se fue. A Esaú no le importaban sus derechos de hijo mayor.

fr.L: Et Jacob donna à Ésaü du pain et un ragoût de lentilles ; et il mangea et but, et il se leva et s’en alla. Ainsi Ésaü méprisa le droit d’aînesse.
fr.B: Alors Jacob donna à Ésaü du pain et du ragoût de lentilles. Ésaü mangea et but, se leva et partit. Voilà le peu de cas qu’Ésaü faisait de son droit d’aînesse.
fr.R: Alors Jacob a donné à Ésaü du pain et une assiette de ragoût de lentilles. Ésaü a mangé et bu. Puis il s’est levé et il est parti. Ésaü ne tenait pas à ses droits de fils aîné.

sw.L: Naye Yakobo akampa Esau mkate na mchuzi wa dengu; akala, akanywa, akainuka, akaenda zake. Hivyo Esau akaudharau uzaliwa wa kwanza.
sw.B: Kisha Yakobo akampa Esau mkate na mchuzi wa dengu. Esau akala, akanywa, akainuka, akaondoka. Ndivyo Esau alivyozipuuza stahili zake za mzaliwa wa kwanza.
sw.R: Basi Yakobo akampa Esau mkate na bakuli la mchuzi wa dengu. Esau akala, akanywa. Kisha akasimama, akaenda zake. Esau hakujali stahili zake za mwana mkubwa.

vi.L: Và Gia-cốp cho Ê-sau bánh và canh đậu lăng; và ông ăn và uống, rồi đứng dậy và đi. Vậy Ê-sau khinh quyền trưởng nam.
vi.B: Rồi Gia-cốp đưa cho Ê-sau bánh và canh đậu lăng. Ê-sau ăn uống xong, đứng dậy bỏ đi. Ê-sau coi rẻ quyền trưởng nam của mình như thế đó.
vi.R: Vậy Gia-cốp đưa cho Ê-sau bánh và một bát canh đậu lăng. Ê-sau ăn và uống. Rồi ông đứng dậy và bỏ đi. Ê-sau không coi trọng quyền làm con trưởng của mình.

ko.L: 그리고 야곱이 에서에게 빵과 팥죽을 주었다. 그리고 그는 먹고 마시고 일어나 갔다. 이렇게 에서는 장자권을 업신여겼다.
ko.B: 야곱이 에서에게 빵과 팥죽을 주었다. 에서는 먹고 마시고는 일어나 가 버렸다. 에서는 맏아들의 권리를 그만큼 하찮게 여겼다.
ko.R: 야곱은 에서에게 빵과 팥죽 한 그릇을 주었다. 에서는 먹고 마셨다. 그리고 일어나서 가 버렸다. 에서는 맏아들의 권리를 소중하게 여기지 않았다.

decisions.choice: he ate and drank and rose and went: a string of quick verbs
decisions.reason: Five short verbs in a row show Esau's haste and lack of thought; the sixth gives the narrator's judgment.

decisions.choice: Esau despised the birthright
decisions.reason: "Despise" (bazah) means to treat as worthless. The narrator lays the blame on Esau, not only on Jacob. Hebrews 12:16 warns against being like Esau, who sold his birthright for a single meal.

decisions.choice: lentils: the red stew
decisions.reason: Lentils cooked as a stew turn reddish brown; this is the "red stuff" of verse 30.

decisions.choice: "팥죽" for the stew of 'adashim (lentils)
decisions.reason: Lentils are a small red legume (meaning decision). "팥죽" is the familiar Korean red bean stew and keeps the red colour that gives Esau his name; "렌즈콩" is the exact plant but strange to most readers. A reviewer may prefer the exact word.
